scope: Existing cells, routes, zones, structures and task locations. No new level generation.
previewLimitations: Offline System.Drawing assembly, not a Unity screenshot or gameplay test.
Border decoration is derived with the existing placement policy and candidate full-canvas extents.
Dynamic people, movable task objects, signal UI and gameplay progress are not replayed; the train uses a fixed open-door display.
Only selected fixed task fixtures are included. The outer eight-cell ceramic environment floor is replaced by a cream review background.
Centre-pivot decal candidates preview their intended mapping; the current runtime loader requires a pivot update.
Overview route and task labels are review overlays, never part of exported art.
